title: Syringaresinol attenuates sepsis-induced cardiac dysfunction by inhibiting inflammation and pyroptosis in mice.
authors: Wei, Ao; Liu, Jingjing; Li, Dihua; Lu, Yanmin; Yang, Lei; Zhuo, Yuzhen; Tian, Wencong; Cong, Hongliang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Syringaresinol通过ER/SIRT1/NLRP3通路减轻脓毒症心肌损伤，属于纯湿实验药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The mortality of sepsis-induced cardiac dysfunction (SICD) is very high due to the complex pathophysiological mechanism. Syringaresinol (SYR) is a natural abstract which possesses anti-inflammatory property. The present study aims was to identify the protective impact of SYR on sepsis-induced cardiac dysfunction and investigate the specific mechanisms. We found that SYR improved the cardiac function and alleviated myocardial injury in mice that subjected to cecal ligation and puncture, in addition, SIRT1 expression was significantly elevated after SYR treatment compared to sepsis group both in vivo and in vitro, along with suppression of NLRP3 activation and proinflammatory cytokines release. However, SIRT1 inhibitor EX427 abolished the impact of SYR on LPS-induced pyroptosis in cardiomyocytes. Furthermore, molecular docking analysis predicted that there is high affinity between SYR and estrogen receptor (ER), ER inhibitor ICI182780, the specific ERbeta inhibitor PHTP and the specific ERalphainhibitor AZD9496 were used to examine the role of ER in the protective effect of SYR against SICD, and the results suggested that ER activation was essential for the cardioprotective function of SYR. In conclusion, SYR ameliorates SICD via the ER/SIRT1/NLRP3/GSDMD pathway.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症诱导的心功能障碍（SICD）的死亡率极高，这归因于其复杂的病理生理机制。Syringaresinol（SYR）是一种具有抗炎特性的天然提取物。本研究旨在确定SYR对脓毒症诱导的心功能障碍的保护作用，并探讨其具体机制。我们发现，SYR改善了接受盲肠结扎穿刺术小鼠的心脏功能并减轻了心肌损伤；此外，与脓毒症组相比，SYR处理后无论在体内还是体外，SIRT1表达均显著升高，同时NLRP3激活和促炎细胞因子释放受到抑制。然而，SIRT1抑制剂EX427消除了SYR对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的心肌细胞焦亡的影响。进一步地，分子对接分析预测SYR与雌激素受体（ER）之间具有高亲和力，我们使用ER抑制剂ICI182780、特异性ERbeta抑制剂PHTP和特异性ERalpha抑制剂AZD9496来检验ER在SYR对抗SICD保护作用中的角色，结果表明ER激活对SYR的心脏保护功能至关重要。总之，SYR通过ER/SIRT1/NLRP3/GSDMD通路改善SICD。
